_comment: What service-kit/ci/smoke.py asks this service after every deploy. Service-owned,
like the rest of deploy/: the kit script is byte-identical everywhere, these routes
are not. Measured on the real process by
tests/integration/test_smoke_against_the_real_process.py, which fails if a route is
renamed or the readiness body changes shape.
success: readiness, not liveness -- /health/live never touches the database, so it
stays green on a deployment that cannot reach it.
denial: /widgets with no credentials. Both PrincipalAuth adapters raise Unauthorized
on a missing credential and app_factory.py maps it to 401. A service that deletes
the worked example must point this at one of its own protected routes.
transport: invoke, because the stack's ApiUrl in deploy/iac/serverless.yml is a
name in the estate's private zone, which a GitHub-hosted runner cannot resolve.
The deploy job asks the function itself with the event the load balancer would
hand it. That does not exercise anything in front of the function: the listener
rule, the target group, the security groups, DNS or TLS. A service whose ApiUrl
is not in the private zone declares http (or leaves this out).
tests/shape/test_deploy_job_is_wired.py holds the declaration to how that URL is
written, not to where it resolves: a Value that names ${env:INTERNAL_ZONE_SUFFIX}
is read as private and any other spelling as public.
